notes.title: BAD END THEATER is coming to consoles!
notes.notes: [p]hey, it's been a while, hasn't it? today i am announcing that Serenity Forge is publishing this game on Nintendo Switch, Xbox, and PlayStation 4 + 5![/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/8PG8q80g/BETannouncement.png"][/img][/p][p]this has been in the works for a really long time so im glad to finally be able to announce it… sorry for the long wait! (I've been trying my best to make it happen all this time lol)[/p][p]the release date is [b]JULY 10TH[/b]!!! mark your calendars!!!!! hehe[/p][p]ah.. i'm so glad we finally made it here... thank you to everyone who supported the game over the years. i hope many new players will be able to experience the power of lesbians... ;)[/p][p]~~~[/p][p]in the meantime, i've been making lots of other games! in case you didn't know!!! my next visual novel was also made in partnership with Serenity Forge, so... please check out [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lz5hM24poMI"]the trailer for Return to Ash[/url]~ and here's the steam page as well:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445830/Return_to_Ash/"][/dynamiclink]thanks for reading![/p]

notes.title: New Steam Release: her tears were my light
notes.notes:
hello! so... this is a late announcement. but i released one of my older games on steam!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112520/her_tears_were_my_light/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2112520/ss_4fde4e63af251753331c49a7f57e7a7b8834d001.1920x1080.jpg?t=1665028954[/img][/url]

if you enjoyed the "lesbians trapped in a time loop" aspect of BAD END THEATER, then i think you'll enjoy this one too :) it's a much shorter and simpler game, but it has just as much love in it.

for more info, check out the game page [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2112520/her_tears_were_my_light/]HERE[/url]!

i'm really sorry for not making this announcement sooner--i actually didn't realize steam allowed you to cross-promote your games like this. and then i was waiting for the chinese translation to be finished, because i know i have a large chinese audience... anyway, i'll be sure to put it on sale again soon, so i hope you'll wishlist if you're interested in playing!

thanks for reading <3

-nami

notes.title: Balance Patch
notes.notes:
hi, everyone! first of all, thanks so much for playing BAD END THEATER!! the response has been way bigger than expected--i'm so happy my game is making such an impact on people <3

i had to do a couple hotfixes within the first couple days of release, but there doesn't seem to have been any major bugs (thank goodness!). there was one bit of feedback i felt i had to address though, thus the balance patch!

[b]**SPOILERS AHEAD!!**[/b]

v1.0.5 updates:
[list]
[*]TRAGEDY now does 5 damage to start (instead of 1), decreasing with each party member you summon. wrong answers will increase TRAGEDY's damage by 1.
[*]a shortcut for total reset has been added to the game menu (appears after you've gone through the resetting process at least once)
[*]music gallery is no longer locked after total reset
[*]minor art fixes
[*]typo fixes for korean and chinese translations
[/list]
thanks again for playing BAD END THEATER! i hope to add more languages in the next update :) stay tuned!

-nami

notes.title: This visual novel is also a puzzle about getting the characters out alive
notes.notes: It's a trope in visual novels that there are more than a few ways to fail, die, get offed, or generally meet up with what is colloquially known as a bad end. Recent release Bad End Theater plays with the idea that Bad Ends are to be avoided, or that they're bad at all. It does that by embracing the puzzle-like metagame of the visual novel, where players like to map out and tweak the world for precisely the ending they'd like... Read more.
